output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The '_transfer' function logic is incorrect. It fails to check if the transfer value is larger than the sender's balance, causing an integer overflow and assigning a negative value to the sender's balance.
The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to cause a denial of service (make any user's balance unreachable).
The 'setPrices' function uses a predictable buyPrice and sellPrice, allowing an attacker to guess these values and manipulate the token's exchange rate.
The 'buy' function has an integer overflow allowing any user to cause a denial of service (buy any arbitrary user's tokens).
